jobs.title: Head of Data Systems (Google Stack)
jobs.description:
The Head of Data Systems (Google Stack) will play a key role at Stacktics, required to help create and maintain industry-leading quality and efficiency of service and software delivery.

Stacktics will rely on the Head of Data Systems with ownership of the Data Systems function including mentoring and support for our team of engineers, developers, marketing analysts and data scientists. The successful candidate will be expected to meet and exceed Stacktics' quality standards, while helping the organization rapidly expand into increasingly complex application development, data engineering, and related workflows.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ownership of Stacktics' Data Systems Business Unit

Build and grow your team's capabilities and expertise to be truly platform-agnostic, ever-adapting based on opportunity and business direction
Lead thorough audits of clients'/prospects' Data Systems, and other associated platforms and technologies as applicable including performance and cloud cost-efficiency
Provide proactive recommendations, identifying areas of opportunity and/or improvement for clients based on their underlying business objectives and goals
Maintain continuous focus on work output quality and reliability, acting as the champion of customer satisfaction in a proactive manner and as the final escalation point for technical and delivery issues that cannot be resolved at the Technical Lead level
Act as Stacktics' primary Data Systems expert, ensuring to maintain and continuously grow personal expertise, and sharing information with other Stacktics team members, client stakeholders and prospects
Collaborate with, support, and work closely with cross-functional units to ensure efficient workflow, and realize cross-functional opportunities and enhancements
Maintain responsibility for the Business Unit's growth and success, continuously developing existing engagements, optimizing resourcing and prospecting
Be dedicated to the success and happiness of your team members, optimizing workflow, enabling their personal growth, and acting as a strong team leader overall

Instilling Development Best Practices and Skills/Procedures Advancement

Establishing, maintaining and evolving DevSecOps best practices and tools, and continuously keeping them aligned with current industry best practices and procedures
Understanding, implementing and automating security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation frameworks
Contributing to deployment tooling within the Stacktics team
Contributing to version control technology frameworks and creating/implementing working processes within the Data Systems team, with tools such as Git or SVN
Own and continuously improve the practice's AI coding standards, the AI coding constitution (CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules), PR checklists, and slash commands keeping them current as tools, clients, and the team's needs evolve

Leading in the Software 3.0 Era

AI tools have changed how fast engineering work gets produced. Your job is to make sure that speed shows up as sounder architecture and higher-quality delivery — not just faster shipping of the same judgment gaps.
Recalibrate how the team scopes and estimates work as AI tooling changes what can actually be delivered in a sprint, so timelines and resourcing plans reflect real AI-era delivery speed
Set architecture and coding standards that assume engineers are using AI assistants daily — code review habits, eval frameworks, and quality gates sized to the failure modes of AI-assisted development, not just its speed
Continue evolving Stacktics' AI Development Lifecycle (ADLC) — our AI-native answer to SDLC — piloting new stages against real engagements and driving adoption across the team
Be an active daily user of AI coding assistants yourself, and bring that firsthand experience into how standards and review practices are set for the team
Lead Stacktics’ technical team members through the integration into Agentic AI-first working patterns, and beyond

Code Productization

Migrating the delivery of the most common/universally applicable solutions from custom projects to formally productized software solutions
Advocating for building repeatability, scalability and standardization into how the Stacktics Data Systems team approaches all work, in order to enable the future migration to productization as a general rule

Data Engineering-Specific Responsibilities

Participate in continuous delivery pipelines to fully automate deployment of the highly available cloud platform that supports multiple projects
Design and develop ETL workflows and datasets to be used in data visualization tools
Write complex SQL queries with multiple joins to automate and manipulate data extracts
Perform end to end Data Validation to maintain accuracy of data sets
Build tools for deployment, monitoring and operations
Troubleshoot and resolve issues in the development, test and production environments
Develop re-usable processes that can be leveraged and standardized for multiple instances
Prepare technical specifications and documentation for projects
Stay up to date on relevant technologies, plug into user groups, understand trends and opportunities to ensure we are using the best possible techniques and tools
Understand, implement, and automate security controls, governance processes, and compliance validation

Contribution to Corporate Strategy

Actively and proactively play a key role in steering Stacktics and affiliated companies, considering market developments, competitive maneuvers, unique opportunities, etc.
You will be expected to both bring new ideas to the table and assist other corporate leaders in vetting/developing concepts and tactics
Identification and tracking of performance, coaching, training needs, and motivating members of the Data Systems team — including Senior Technical Leads. Directly or indirectly responsible for hiring, terminating and owning performance evaluations for direct reports and the Data Systems group

Company-Wide Responsibilities

Maintain and exceed client satisfaction with Stacktics’ deliverables, day-to-day work and overall value as a partner
Adapt to ever-changing client needs and expectations
Maintain dedication toward achieving excellence in Stacktics’ delivery against client needs, and overall success as an organization
Ability to provide clear guidance and support for advanced problem solving and system design to large teams at enterprise-level client companies, aiding the evolution of their digital practices

QUALIFICATIONS

Deep expertise in building and managing large-scale data systems on cloud platforms, with a strong preference for Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services
Python, SQL and Cloud Computing
10+ years experience in Data Engineering, including 6+ years in technical leadership or management roles, with experience managing other leads (e.g., Technical Leads or engineering managers).
Strong understanding of and direct experience with managing a team operating in a “Software 3.0” model (Agentic AI-first)
Active user of AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent), and fluent in what they change about estimation, architecture, and review
Understanding of digital ecosystems including online data collection, cloud systems and analytics tools (Google Stack, Facebook, Salesforce, Adobe Suite etc.) a strong asset
Strong technical understanding of a range of marketing concepts such as cookie-based data collection, setting and leveraging audience segments, attribution modelling, AB/N & multivariate is an asset
Excellent written & verbal communication skills are essential; candidate should be comfortable presenting and participating in group discussions of concepts with internal and external stakeholders
Candidate must exhibit an analytical, detail-oriented approach to problem solving
Experience with Jira / Atlassian project management tools is an asset

Preferred Qualifications

Google Cloud certifications (e.g., Professional Cloud Architect, Professional Data Engineer) are a strong plus.
Prior experience in a consulting environment, managing and delivering projects for multiple clients concurrently.

jobs.title: Director of Finance
jobs.description:
Toronto or Waterloo, hybrid | Full-time | Reports to the CEO

Build the finance function at a fast-growing senior care technology company shipping hardware to 24 countries.

The Company

We went from a lab in Waterloo to 24 countries in five years. Our sensors detect falls and track sleep, health and wellness, with no cameras, wearables or pendants. Families get peace of mind. Older adults keep their independence. Our CTO, Dr. Yihong Qi, holds 680 patents, and the next few hundred get built here.

Why now

We are scaling. One of the largest deals in our history is in delivery, our consumer product launches in January, and we are preparing our next raise. Every one of those runs on numbers leadership can trust: a close that lands on time, a forecast that ties sales to inventory and cash, and books that hold up in diligence. This is the moment to bring in the leader who owns it.

The role

This is the senior finance role at Pontosense. You own the close, the forecast, controls and the numbers behind our next raise, across our entities in Canada and China. You work directly with the CEO and the leadership team, and you are in the room with investors. This is a builder role first and an operator role second. You set up how finance runs here, then you run it.

What You'll Own

A monthly close that is reliable and consolidated across Canada and China, landing by business day 10
A forecast the company actually runs on, with sales, inventory and cash tied together
Product costing that is right: landed cost, COGS and inventory planning for hardware built overseas
The raise: the model, the data room and investor reporting, with you in the room
Annual financials prepared and audited on time, and the relationships with our auditors and tax advisors
Controls that hold up across two countries: approvals, spend and intercompany
A seat at the leadership table

What Year One Looks Like

The books close on time every month, consolidated. The forecast is trusted, and inventory is planned, not guessed. Audited financials are current, and our next raise runs on numbers that hold up in diligence.

How We Work

Build it right, then make it better. People's safety rides on what we ship, so we test hard and never settle for good enough.
Say it as it is. Kind and direct, at every level, including the CEO.
Real impact. There is more room to make a difference here than at a company ten times our size.
Do what you said. Trust is built on follow-through, and we return it with real ownership.
Hard, and worth it. What we build keeps someone's parent safe at home. Rest well, it's part of the job.

This is for you if

You'd rather own a problem than be assigned a task
You want the mission to matter and the pace to be real
You're happy to be the person who just fixes it

This isn't for you if

You want a playbook handed to you
You need a big team before you can move

You'll thrive here if

You are a CPA who started in audit, then grew with a product or technology company, with promotions along the way
You have owned the close and built the model yourself, not just reviewed them
You have run FP&A, not only the close: budgets, forecasts and the model leadership makes decisions on
You have worked with inventory, COGS and supply chain costing. Multi-entity or international consolidation is a strong plus
You have worked with investors, a board or lenders, or are ready to step into that
You explain the numbers plainly to people outside finance, and decide with incomplete information
You are as happy reconciling an account yourself as setting the strategy

You don't need to check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.

Where this goes

As we raise and scale, this role grows into leading a finance team of your own.

What You Get

A sensor for your parents, on us
Direct access to the leadership team. No layers.
Fair pay, with the opportunity for equity
Impact decides your pay and your path, not tenure
Hybrid in Toronto or Waterloo, remote if that's where you do your best work
Health, dental and vision benefits

The details

Pay: $160,000 to $190,000 CAD base salary
This is a new role, created to grow the team, not a backfill
How we hire: typically an initial interview, a short case, and a final interview in person with our CEO and members of the team. We may adjust this depending on the role
We leverage AI tools in our hiring process, but prioritize human input and manual review

Our Commitment

At Pontosense, we are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and accessible to all. We value diversity and believe that everyone deserves an equal opportunity to succeed.

If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know. We will work with you to make the necessary accommodations to ensure a fair and positive experience for all applicants.

We strive to provide accessible communication and technology for our employees and customers and always look for ways to improve. If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve accessibility in our workplace, please don't hesitate to contact us.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply for open positions at our company.

About The Company BuildGood is a fundraising growth agency. We help nonprofits change the way they find new donors, retain them longer, and grow lifetime value, building a system that creates moments of generosity from first-time giver to legacy leaver.

Our approach is rooted in understanding why people give. Generosity grows when people feel motivated—when giving supports their identity, creates a sense of connection, and makes supporters feel competent and effective in their giving. We design fundraising systems around building donor motivation and leading first-time donors to become committed supporters.

We partner with nonprofits across North America to grow durable revenue, from donor acquisition and direct mail to digital fundraising, retention, and mid-level giving. Our work blends brand and direct response.

Is This Job For You? Do you get fired up about turning client relationships into long-term, high-impact partnerships?

Do you understand what it takes to grow fundraising and be responsible for revenue targets, and know
how to help others turn that understanding into stronger strategies and better results?

Are you energized by leading a team of Strategists and Account Managers, challenging their thinking, building their confidence, and helping them manage client relationships well?

Can you look at a client’s fundraising program, identify the biggest opportunities, and help your team build a clear plan for growth?

Are you comfortable leading important client conversations, addressing concerns directly, and making the case for renewing or expanding a partnership?

And do you want to build a high-performance client strategy function at a fundraising agency that’s genuinely changing how nonprofits grow?

We’re looking for someone who combines deep fundraising knowledge with strong account management and people leadership. You’ll lead the team that owns our client accounts, set the standard for strategy and client experience, and take responsibility for keeping and growing those partnerships.

What We Offer A workplace that values your need for autonomy, competence and connection
An entrepreneurial culture that places a premium on rigor and accountability
A teamwork environment built on both humour and challenging each other to continuously improve in our craft
Meaningful work that directly influences how organizations grow
Attendance at the Build Good Summit, Canada’s premiere fundraising conference
Work from home anywhere in Canada
4 weeks vacation
Summer Fridays (Fridays off in June, July, and August)
Generous professional development budget
Group Retirement Savings Plan (GRSP)
Flexible Spending Account (HSA)
Performance pay based on meeting goals and targets

What You’ll Do

You will own the strategy and execution for how our client team grows and protects BuildGood’s client portfolio. Your focus will be on client success, retention, renewals, expansion, and the profitability of each account—ensuring our work delivers measurable fundraising results, gives clients a clear reason to deepen their partnership with us, and generates a healthy profit for BuildGood.

You will set the direction for BuildGood’s client strategy function and lead the team responsible for putting it into practice. You’ll manage our Fundraising Strategists and Account Managers, set the standard for fundraising strategy and account management, and own all renewals and expansion across the client portfolio.

Every account will have a clear growth plan that connects the client’s fundraising goals with the work, investment, and decisions needed to achieve them. You’ll help your team build those plans, hold them accountable for progress, and ensure clients understand the value of our work and where the partnership can go next.

You’ll lead through your team while participating directly in strategic reviews, important client conversations, renewals, and escalations. You’ll work closely with the Managing Director, who provides commercial leadership and sets pricing, margin, and other business parameters.

Your main responsibilities:
Lead, coach, and develop BuildGood’s Fundraising Strategists and Account Managers through regular 1:1s, account reviews, clear performance expectations, and professional development.
Review and challenge the fundraising strategy across the client portfolio. Review and challenge recommendations to ensure they reflect donor insights, performance data, and the client’s goals.
Own and iterate the Total Fundraising Review & Revenue Roadmap, our flagship diagnostic, forecasting and planning process at the beginning of each new client relationship built on our Brand → Demand → Expand and Fundraising FlywheelTM IP.
Work closely with the Creative Director to ensure the work we deliver is outstanding—grounded in a strong fundraising strategy, built around donor insights, and executed with exceptional craft. Together, review key campaigns and deliverables, challenge work that falls short, and coach the team toward a consistently high standard.
Ensure every account has a documented growth plan covering fundraising priorities, measurable goals, recommended investment, renewal timing, relationship risks, and opportunities to expand the partnership.
Make annual planning and Quarterly Fundraising Reviews the foundation of account management, ensuring each review leads to clear recommendations, decisions, and next steps.
Hold the team accountable for executing account plans, monitoring results, and adjusting strategy when performance or circumstances change.
Own renewal planning and execution across the portfolio. Maintain a clear renewal calendar and forecast, prepare the team, and lead renewal conversations within the commercial parameters agreed with the Managing Director.
Identify and advance opportunities to expand client partnerships where additional BuildGood services or investment would help the client achieve its fundraising goals.
Monitor account health using fundraising performance, client feedback, engagement, and relationship strength. Act early when results, trust, or renewal prospects are at risk.
Serve as the senior escalation point for client challenges. Lead the response, coordinate the right people, communicate clearly with the client, and follow through to resolution.
Ensure client strategies, presentations, and reports are clear, credible, and useful. Help the team explain what happened, what it means, and what should happen next.
Partner with creative, data, digital, production, and project management leaders to ensure work follows the agreed strategy and meets client expectations.

All accounting functions and internal controls

The SandboxAQ AI Generation Engine (SAIGE) team’s mission is to accelerate SandboxAQ’s mission of “Deep Impact at Scale”

Build next-generation AI capabilities that establish SandboxAQ as the global pacesetter in quantitative AI.
Identify, incubate, prototype, and launch new AI products for high-potential and longer-term use cases, proving (or disproving) their viability as high-impact, highly profitable business lines.

The SAIGE team operates on the following principles: Prototype with Velocity, Explore Boldly, Fail Smart, Learn Fast, Look Forward, and Share Knowledge.

Our current top priority use case is leveraging AI and LQMs to solve some of the most impactful problems in the Finance and Insurance industries.

The Opportunity

As The Director Of Product Management For The AI Generation Engine (SAIGE), You Will Be The PM Lead For The Team And a Key Partner To Engineering, Research, And User Research. You Will

Own the product strategy and execution for our efforts in Finance & Risk Modeling, partnering closely with financial services and insurance customers to understand their workflows, risk models, and decision-making processes.
Lead rapid prototyping and innovation across a broad range of new ideas and domains, driving 0→1 product discovery, experimentation, and incubation of high-potential use cases.
Operate in a highly ambiguous, fast-changing environment, providing clarity on priorities, making pragmatic trade-offs, and ensuring we ship impactful prototypes and products.

This role is ideal for a seasoned product leader who is energized by uncertainty, enjoys working across disciplines (UXR, engineering, research, business), and is excited to build new AI and quantitative products from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

Lead product strategy in Finance & Risk Modeling

Own the product vision, roadmap, and execution for our Finance/Risk portfolio, with a focus on financial services and insurance (e.g., portfolio risk, capital modeling, risk analytics, underwriting, and related workflows).
Develop a deep understanding of customer contexts, including current tools, models, and data flows (e.g., portfolio / risk modeling systems, vendor platforms, internal analytics stacks).
Partner with quantitative researchers, ML engineers, and domain experts to translate customer problems into clear product requirements and model/data needs.
Define success metrics and validation strategies to compare our approaches against existing PML/ERM and portfolio views, and to demonstrate differentiated value.

Drive rapid prototyping and 0→1 innovation

Identify, evaluate, and prioritize new AI / LQM use cases across multiple domains (beyond Finance/Risk), from early signals to clearer opportunities.
Lead 0→1 product discovery: problem framing, hypothesis development, lightweight customer validation, and rapid iteration on prototypes.
Work with engineering and research to scope experiments that are small enough to move quickly but meaningful enough to answer key questions.
Establish and champion a rigorous but pragmatic approach to ruthless prioritization, ensuring the team focuses on the highest-impact opportunities.

Build strong customer and stakeholder relationships

Serve as a trusted product partner to senior stakeholders at key customers (e.g., heads of risk, portfolio managers, actuaries, CROs), speaking credibly about risk models, scenarios, and portfolio decisions.
Lead customer conversations from initial discovery through pilot definition and ongoing adoption, connecting customer needs to the SAIGE roadmap.
Communicate progress, learnings, and recommendations clearly to internal and external stakeholders, including executives.

You are a senior product leader who is comfortable at the intersection of AI, quantitative modeling, and financial risk
. You thrive in ambiguity, enjoy working closely with deeply technical teams, and can just as easily go deep on models and data as you can on customer needs and business outcomes. You are proactive, low-ego, and collaborative, and you don’t need rigid structure to have impact.

10+ years of product management experience, with substantial time spent on complex B2B or platform products; at least several years operating at a senior / staff / principal / director level (e.g., L7-equivalent scope).
Deep Experience in financial services and/or insurance, especially in one or more of:
Risk modeling (e.g., portfolio risk, capital modeling, asset-liability management, market/credit risk, or insurance risk)
Financial simulation or scenario analysis
Portfolio analytics or decision support tools

Demonstrated ability to work closely with quantitative and engineering teams:
Past experience in building AI / ML products or capabilities
Comfortable discussing models, data pipelines, and trade-offs with engineers and researchers.
Able to translate between technical details and customer/business value.

Proven track record of 0→1 product work:
Identifying new opportunities and shaping them from idea to prototype and early product.
Working through high ambiguity, incomplete information, and changing constraints.

Strong ruthless prioritization skills: can define clear frameworks, make hard trade-offs, and say “no” to good ideas to focus on the best ones.
Exceptional customer-facing skills:
Confident leading discovery and roadmap conversations with senior stakeholders.
Skilled at uncovering real needs behind stated requirements and pressure-testing problem statements.

Demonstrated ability to drive execution without heavy process or structure:
Self-directed, proactive, and comfortable creating structure where needed rather than waiting for it.
Experience in environments with shifting priorities and evolving strategies.

Strong collaboration and communication:
Experience working tightly with UXR, design, engineering, and research.
Clear written and verbal communication across technical and non-technical audiences.

Alignment with SandboxAQ values and the SAIGE principles around rapid prototyping, learning, and shared ownership.

Direct experience building products involving AI / ML, foundational models, quantitative models, or LLM/agentic systems.
Hands-on exposure to risk tools and vendor platforms (e.g., risk engines, portfolio analytics systems, or modeling platforms used in insurance and financial services).
Experience in both:
A high-growth startup or new product incubation context, and
A large, complex environment (e.g., Big Tech, major financial institution), giving you a strong sense of how to navigate stakeholders and scale impact.

Educational background in a quantitative or technical field (e.g., computer science, mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, finance, or similar).

If you’re excited by the idea of shaping the future of quantitative AI, building products with real impact in finance and insurance (and possibly other domains), and leading 0→1 innovation in a highly cross-functional team, we’d love to hear from you.
